# Homeward: extra assets

The three overlays are used by website phases 5 and 6; sound is optional but changes the feel a lot; the rest is polish. The site runs without any of them.

## Overlays

Generate the two loops on a pure black background; the site blends them with screen, so black disappears.

| File | Used in | Prompt | Spec |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dust.mp4 | house and library (c05 to c07) | Slow floating dust motes drifting in a warm beam of sunlight, pure black background, shallow depth of field, no objects, no walls, no people | 6 s seamless loop, 1080p |
| mist.mp4 | valley and descent (c03 to c04) | Soft low mist drifting slowly left to right, thin layered ground fog, pure black background, no ground, no objects | 8 s seamless loop, 1080p |
| paper.webp | book chapters (c06 to c08) | Seamless tileable close-up texture of aged cream rag paper with fine fibres and faint foxing, flat even light, no marks, no text | square, 1024 px, tileable |

## Sound

Use a sound-effects generator for the clips and a music generator for the bed. Each loop should be seamless; the site crossfades them for 1.2 seconds when the chapter changes.

| Clip | Prompt | Length |
| --- | --- | --- |

## Phones

The plan is to crop the 16:9 clips to the centre third on phones; every keyframe already keeps its subject there, and the site stores a focal point per chapter. That costs nothing. A separate vertical set would mean generating all ten clips again at 9:16 with the same prompts and re-framed keyframes; do it only if the crop disappoints. To re-frame a keyframe for that, attach it and use this:

```text
Re-compose this image as a vertical 9:16 frame. Extend the scene above and below, keep the subject exactly as it is in the centre, and keep the lighting, colours and level of detail identical. Add no new objects.
```

## Poster, share image and mark

- **Poster and loading frame:** export K05 (the valley) at 1920 x 1080; it is the site's first paint and the no-script fallback.
- **Share image:** crop K08 (the open book) to 1200 x 630, centre on the photograph; the title is added by the site, not by the image tool.
- **Mark:** A single-stroke line mark of an eye whose pupil is a small house, ink on transparent, square. Ask for an SVG; website phase 7 can also draw it in code.
